title: Affiliate & Monetization Disclosure
label: Legal
description: FTC affiliate disclosure for Alex Journeys — commissions, partner examples, /tools outbound links, and that opinions are Alex’s own.
contentHtml:
Effective / last updated: September 20, 2026

This page is the FTC-style affiliate & monetization disclosure for Alex Journeys. Short version: some links can earn a small commission; opinions stay Alex's own; you never pay more because you clicked through here.

How affiliate links work

This journal participates in affiliate and partner programs. When you click certain links and book or buy something, Alex Journeys may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. Those commissions help keep the journal online (hosting, tools, time on the road).

Affiliate relationships do not dictate what gets published. Recommendations are based on personal use and trust — not whoever pays the most.

Where you'll see them

  • The Tools I use page (/tools) — outbound partner links for stays, flights, insurance, money, connectivity, and similar.
  • Guides, destination notes, and story posts when a tool or booking partner is genuinely relevant.
  • Occasional sponsored or partner content — clearly labeled when it is sponsored.

Example partners

Partners may include (this list can change over time): Viator, GetYourGuide, Booking.com, Expedia, RentCars.com, World Nomads, Wise, Babbel, and similar travel or lifestyle services. Ads such as Google AdSense may also appear when enabled.

Opinions are my own

Reviews, tips, and “I use this” notes reflect Alex's experience. Partners do not get editorial control over what is written. If something is gifted or sponsored, it will be disclosed.

FTC disclosure

In line with U.S. Federal Trade Commission guidelines, material connections (affiliates, sponsorships, gifted products) are disclosed. If you have questions about a specific link, email contact@alexjourneys.com.
